title: PM-KUSUM 2.0 to include a dedicated 10 GW agrivoltaics component
detail: Announced by the Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy at the 4th National Agro-RE Summit in New Delhi.

title: Over 10 lakh standalone solar pumps installed and over 13 lakh grid-connected pumps solarised under PM-KUSUM
detail: Cumulative figures stated by the Minister at the Agro-RE Summit.

title: PM-KUSUM project completion deadline extended to 31 March 2027
detail: Applies to eligible projects with PPAs or NTPs issued by 31 December 2025.

title: National Forum on Solarization of Agriculture
detail: Hybrid forum at ICAR-IARI with IWMI on irrigation, farm operations and agrivoltaics.

title: Madhya Pradesh MoU with Indo-German Cooperation on Agrivoltaics
detail: Covers project development, policy support, financing, research and farmer capacity-building; valid until May 2030.

title: AgriVoltaics World Conference 2026
detail: Hosted by MNRE with IGCA support, 21-23 October, New Delhi, with a technical tour of Delhi agrivoltaic sites.

title: Winter School on Agrivoltaics 2026
detail: Four-day school, 26-29 October, by IWMI and ICAR-IARI-NISE CoE on AgriPV with University of Freiburg.
